title: Receivers and Readers on the Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program: Coverage, Intervals and Cash Prices
content:
A CGM receiver or reader (E2103) is covered on some tiers of the Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program and not on others; customers using the smartphone app need none.

## Coverage and intervals by tier

| Tier | Receiver or reader covered | Minimum time between covered receivers (calendar months from the previous receiver's ship date) | Manufacturer warranty (calendar months from delivery) |
|---|---|---|---|
| CGM Self-Pay Program | No | 0 | 12 |
| CGM Commercial HMO Program | No | 0 | 12 |
| CGM Commercial PPO Program | Yes | 36 | 12 |
| CGM Medicare Advantage Program | Yes | 60 | 12 |
| CGM Original Medicare Program | Yes | 60 | 12 |
| CGM Medicaid Program | Yes | 36 | 12 |

A replacement interval of 0 means receivers are not covered on the tier.

## Larkfield cash price of a receiver or reader, by model (identical on every tier)

| CGM model | Receiver or reader cash price |
|---|---|
| Dexcom G7 | 389.00 USD |
| Dexcom G7 15 Day | 389.00 USD |
| Dexcom G6 | 389.00 USD |
| FreeStyle Libre 3 Plus | 73.29 USD |
| FreeStyle Libre 2 Plus | 69.99 USD |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

On a hypothetical tier with a 24-month interval, a previous receiver shipped on 15 June of one year leaves the next covered receiver available from 15 June two years later.
